text:
[RFCS.7a.1] A `FactWithdraw` atom records the **engine** taking back a fact it
was holding. Its counterpart on the integrator side is `FactRetract`
([RFCS.7.1]).

*Withdraw* is the corpus own word for the engine side: `[IRET.12.2]` is
titled "Justification withdrawal" and `[LLOG.15.1]` speaks of "the same
justification withdrawal, whatever ends the match".
